summary: Backend testing of Superadmin Dashboard endpoints (/api/admin/overview, /api/admin/users, /api/admin/feedback) plus metrics middleware. 12/12 pytest cases pass covering superadmin access (200), non-superadmin (403), unauthenticated (401), and response shape validation. Seed data was inserted directly into Mongo (Google OAuth is not automatable) and fully cleaned up on teardown so the real first Google user still becomes admin.

minor.issue: test_credentials.md lists SUPERADMIN_EMAILS seeding guidance only briefly. Documentation-only, not a bug.
pytest.ini enables xdist parallel by default (gw0 seen). test_admin_dashboard.py fixture writes to a unique-indexed email; must be run with -n 0. Documented in run command.

action_items: No fixes required — all admin dashboard endpoints and metrics middleware behave as specified.
When running the admin dashboard suite in future iterations, use: `cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_admin_dashboard.py -n 0 -v` (parallel workers cause duplicate-key on unique email index).
critical_code_review_comments: is_superadmin() (server.py:54-55) is a simple case-insensitive email lookup against SUPERADMIN_EMAILS env — good.
Admin endpoints (server.py:1608-1701) correctly gate every call with is_superadmin(user) before any DB work and use _serialize() to strip Mongo _id.
metrics_middleware (server.py:1996-2023) captures both raised exceptions and >=500 responses into error_logs; recent_errors surfaces in overview.tech correctly.
server.py is ~2038 lines — consider splitting admin/payments/chat routers into separate modules (file-size guideline >700 lines).
seed_data_creation: Fixture seeds 1 superadmin (email=emmusic.indonesia@gmail.com), 1 non-superadmin user, both with valid user_sessions (+7d); 4 trees (2 free / 1 pro / 1 family), 1 paid payment_order (Rp 149000), 1 feedback item, and 1 synthetic error_log. All wiped on teardown (users/user_sessions/trees/tree_members/people/relations/invites/meta/person_notes/family_chat/app_notifications/join_requests/chat_typing/chat_rooms/chat_mutes/payment_orders/feedback/error_logs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_admin_dashboard.py -n 0 -v` — parallel workers break the fixture because users.email has a unique index. Superadmin email is `emmusic.indonesia@gmail.com` (set in backend/.env SUPERADMIN_EMAILS). is_superadmin() lives at server.py:54-55; admin endpoints at server.py:1608-1701; metrics middleware at server.py:1996-2023.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All specified acceptance criteria met.
